findings.what: All TPS5430 pins connected per datasheet pinout: BOOT, GND, COMP, VSENSE, ENA, PGND, PH, VIN
All AMS1117 pins connected: VIN (pin 1 + tab), VOUT (pin 2), GND (pin 3)
All WL2808 pins connected: VIN, GND, EN (tied to VIN), NC (unconnected), VOUT
Feedback resistor values (10k/2.43k) calculated for ~4.1V output; needs refinement to exactly 5.0V in simulation
All capacitors are ceramic X7R as required by LDO datasheets (no tantalums)
Bootstrap capacitor C2 connects BOOT to PH (switch node) as per TPS5430 datasheet Fig. 15
Power dissipation: Buck ~0.5W, LDO1 ~0.51W, LDO2 ~0.21W - all within package thermal limits
WL2808 outputs 1.2V instead of RP2040's nominal 1.1V, but within RP2040 DVDD spec (1.08-1.32V)
No reverse-polarity protection on 12V input - assuming upstream protection
Voltage compatibility verified: 12V → TPS5430 (4.4V-36V range OK), 5V → AMS1117 (up to 15V OK), 3.3V → WL2808 (up to 5.5V OK)

not_verified: Inductor L1 saturation current rating (must be > 3A, not specified in circuit)
Actual 5V output voltage with R2=10k, R3=2.43k (calculated 4.11V, needs adjustment to 5.0V)
PCB layout requirements: PH node area minimization, Kelvin sensing for VSENSE pin
